content.thinking:
The deep-nesting generator produced only 64 records — because all 3125 starts collapsed: `(i * 7919 + 12345) & 0xffffffff00000000` — the mask keeps only the top 32 bits, and `i*7919+12345` for i < 3125 is at most ~24.7M which is < 2^32, so the top 32 bits are always 0! All starts were 0. Oops. Let me fix: use distinct high bits.

Let me regenerate with starts spread across the upper 32 bits.

content.text: My deep-nesting generator collapsed all starts to 0 (mask bug). Fixing:

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && python3 -c "
recs = []
for i in range(3125):
    s = ((i * 7919 + 12345) << 32) & ((1<<64)-1)   # distinct high 32 bits
    for ln in range(1, 65):
        start = s & (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln))
        recs.append((start, ln))
seen = set(); out = []
for (st, ln) in recs:
    if (st, ln) in seen: continue
    seen.add((st, ln)); out.append((st, ln))
print('records:', len(out))
import random; random.Random(1).shuffle(out)
with open('deep.txt','w') as f:
    for (st, ln) in out:
        w = [(st>>48)&0xffff,(st>>32)&0xffff,(st>>16)&0xffff,st&0xffff,0,0,0,0]
        f.write(':'.join('%x'%x for x in w) + '/%d %d\n' % (ln, st % (1<<32)))
" && time /work/submit/planb64 build deep.txt deep.idx && echo "rows=$(sed -n 2p deep.idx)" && time /work/submit/planb64 lookup deep.idx deep_trace.txt batch 256 | md5sum && time /work/submit/planb64 lookup deep.idx deep_trace.txt scalar | md5sum
